jobs.occupation: Senior Project Manager  R&D, Embedded Systems & Power Electronics - 20485
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead a development project involving distributed control and communication systems for advanced power electronics applications.
The project covers controller hardware, embedded software, real-time communication, redundancy functions, and system verification. The focus is on delivering a reliable, secure, and highly available distributed control platform.
What You Will Work On
Lead cross-functional development teams across systems, hardware, software, and verification.
Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, and risks.
Drive project execution and ensure delivery against objectives, timelines, and quality targets.
Coordinate activities between system architects, developers, and test teams.
Monitor progress, identify risks, and report milestones to management and steering committees.
Facilitate project planning, governance, and decision-making.
Ensure effective collaboration across technical disciplines throughout the development lifecycle.

What You Bring
At least 8 years of experience in technical project management.
Proven experience leading complex hardware and software development projects.
Experience in energy, industrial automation, telecommunications, defense, automotive, or similar engineering industries.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Good understanding of system development, integration, and verification.
Fluency in written and spoken English.
Ability to lead structured project execution in complex engineering environments.

Meritorious
Experience with distributed control systems.
Knowledge of embedded and real-time systems.
Experience with Ethernet, EtherCAT, or industrial communication networks.
Knowledge of functional safety and cybersecurity.
Experience in the energy sector.

Holsfjord Produkter DA is looking for an experienced and reliable tractor driver for the 2027 season.
We are a vegetable farm in Sylling, Lier, approximately 40 km west of Oslo. We grow iceberg lettuce, Chinese cabbage, cauliflower, and kale.

The job
Your main tasks will be tractor and machinery operation, including soil preparation, planting, and cultivation. 

Other duties include:
.Moving and handling irrigation equipment
.Daily checks and basic maintenance of machinery
.Transporting vegetables from the fields to cooling and storage facilities
.Loading and unloading produce and equipment
.Helping with planting, harvesting, and other physical farm work when needed

What we are looking for
.Experience operating tractors and agricultural machinery
.A valid driving licence: category T, C, or BE
.Ability to speak and understand English
.Someone who works independently, takes care of equipment, and is willing to help with different tasks

What we offer
.Seasonal employment from April to September 2027
.NOK 190-215 per hour before tax, depending on experience and qualifications
.Guaranteed 40 hours per week, with an expected average of around 45 hours depending on the season, weather, and workload
.Employment conditions in accordance with Norwegian labour laws, including overtime compensation, holiday pay, pension, and employee insurance
.Accommodation available on the farm with a private room; rental price to be confirmed
.A friendly and supportive working environment
.Opportunity to return for future seasons - we hope to find someone who will work with us for many years

How to apply
Send a short introduction and a few details about your experience to holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com. Please include which tractors and implements you have used and when you are available to work.
Please include a reference from a previous employer, if available. You are welcome to attach a CV.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

For questions, contact:
John Rasmus Swang | Farm Manager
holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

Join Windy Scandinavia in Västervik building exclusive boats! Seeking craftsmen in fiberglass, carpentry, electrical & mechanics. Full-time with housing available.

Windy Scandinavia, a well-known brand in the boat industry, develops and manufactures exclusive boats that are becoming larger and more technically advanced. The boat models range from 26 to 77 feet.
Eterni is now looking for craftsmen to strengthen Windys production team in Västervik.

CURRENT JOB ROLES
Plastic Processing & Lamination: You work with everything from hand lay-up and injection to mold work and sanding.
Assembly & Carpentry: You assemble interiors, custom-fit wooden parts, decks, and equipment with high precision.
Marine Electronics & Electrical Installation: You install wiring, electrical systems, navigation equipment, and advanced control systems.
Mechanics & Engine Installation: You install engines, drivetrains, hydraulics, and plumbing systems.
Surface Treatment & Finish/Polish: You ensure that gelcoat, paint, and surfaces are absolutely world-class before delivery.

PERSONAL QUALITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS
We are looking for both those of you who have experience in boat building or alternatively have professional skills that are applicable within boat construction.
To succeed in your role, it is important that you:
Have high craftsmanship skills and are good with tools.
Are used to working with high demands for precision.
Are humble and are happy to lend a helping hand to others in the company.
Understand and can read and work based on drawings and instructions.
Swedish or English language is required, both spoken and written.

ABOUT THE POSITION
The job as a craftsman is a full-time consulting assignment. You will be employed by Eterni and work with Windy Scandinavia. See the website windyboats.com. Accommodation is available in Västervik. Availability to work two shifts is a requirement.

OTHER INFORMATION
Apply by registering at eterni.se and attach your CV and cover letter. For questions, contact Linda Malmros at 070-340 86 33, linda.malmros@eterni.se.

WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION!

ManoMotion is a Swedish deep-tech company developing cutting-edge AI and computer vision technologies that enable machines to understand human movements and intentions. Our solutions are applied across industrial safety, robotics, and human-machine interaction.
We are looking for a Junior Embedded Systems Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the development and deployment of real-time AI-powered solutions on embedded platforms.
In this role, you will work with C++, embedded Linux, camera systems, and AI model integration, collaborating closely with our computer vision and machine learning engineers. You will contribute to software development, hardware integration, system testing, and real-world customer deployments.
QualificationsRequired Qualifications
Master’s degree in Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

Experience with C++ and/or Python through academic projects, internships, or professional work.

Good understanding of embedded systems, software development, and hardware-software integration.

Familiarity with sensors, electronics, and basic laboratory equipment such as multimeters and oscilloscopes.

Ability to develop, test, debug, and document software running on embedded hardware.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on engineering mindset.

Good communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Proficiency in written and spoken English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with embedded Linux, particularly NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

Familiarity with RGB, infrared, or depth cameras and sensor integration.

Basic understanding of computer vision, machine learning, or AI model deployment on embedded devices.

Experience with real-time processing, performance optimization, or edge AI applications.

Familiarity with Git, debugging tools, and software testing on physical hardware.

Experience with robotics, automation, industrial systems, or human-machine interaction.

Previous hands-on experience through internships, research projects, or personal engineering projects.

What We Value
Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI, embedded technologies, and solving real-world engineering challenges.

A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to take ownership of technical tasks.

Comfort working in a small, fast-moving team where you can make a meaningful contribution.

About the role
We are looking for a Data Center Engineer to support the installation, operation and maintenance of data center infrastructure. You will help ensure that servers, storage, networks and supporting facilities operate securely and reliably.
You will work closely with infrastructure teams, facilities specialists and external vendors to resolve incidents, deliver changes and maintain service availability.
Key responsibilities
Install, configure and maintain servers, storage systems and network equipment.

Perform rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacements and structured cabling.

Monitor infrastructure health, investigate faults and coordinate incident resolution.

Support operating system maintenance, patching and hardware lifecycle management.

Carry out approved changes using documented procedures, validation checks and rollback plans.

Support backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities.

Maintain asset inventories, rack layouts, cabling records and operational documentation.

Coordinate with facilities teams on power, cooling, environmental monitoring and physical security.

Work with vendors on maintenance, equipment deliveries and hardware support.

Follow access controls, safety procedures and change management processes.

Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support where required.

Required qualifications
Relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure support or a similar technical role.

Hands-on knowledge of server hardware, storage and networking fundamentals.

Experience with Linux and/or Windows Server environments.

Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V or KVM.

Familiarity with fiber and copper cabling, rack infrastructure and hardware diagnostics.

Understanding of incident management, change management and operational documentation.

Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams and vendors.

Professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with SAN/NAS storage, backup platforms or disaster recovery testing.

Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.

Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python or Ansible.

Exposure to cloud connectivity and hybrid infrastructure.

Relevant certifications in networking, servers, virtualization or IT service management.

Hello Clean is hiring reliable cleaners in Stockholm — and we welcome international students already living in Sweden.
This is Hello Clean in Stockholm.
You might have seen our ads on buses or on TV. At Hello Clean, we’re looking for more stars to join our amazing team of cleaning pros. If you love delivering sparkling results and going the extra mile for customers, we’re the perfect workplace for you!
👉 Apply here: https://helloclean.se/jobb-student-stadare/

Who are you?
You can communicate in Swedish or English
You need to be thorough and like to give your customers that little extra ✨

Importante to note:
You must have a valid work permit in Sweden. EU/EES students have the automatic right to work here. Non-EU/EES students with a residence permit can in most cases work alongside their studies without any hour restrictions — check your permit card for details.

Do you enjoy creating structure, ensuring accuracy, and keeping complex projects on track? Are you someone who thrives in a collaborative environment where attention to detail makes a real difference? Perido is now looking for a Document Controller who wants to play an important role in supporting a major project within the green energy and manufacturing sector. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a large-scale initiative while working closely with a dynamic team!
About the position
Perido are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Document Controller to join our client’s team. The client company is an industrial company driving large-scale initiatives in green energy and manufacturing. This role is essential to ensuring the integrity, accessibility, and traceability of the technical documentation and data that support the success of one of our client’s large-scale projects. The role is based at the client’s office in Stockholm, where you are expected to be on-site minimum three days per week.
Your daily tasks
As a Document Controller, you will be responsible for managing project documentation, supporting the implementation and continuous improvement of the Electronic Document Management System (EDMS), and acting as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. The role involves close collaboration across different functions, where you will promote best practices within the wider project delivery team. You will also ensure that Document Control processes are followed and clearly communicated as part of the project onboarding.
Key responsibilities:
Become a subject matter expert in EDMS (OMEGA 365), providing system support and guidance to the project team
Configure and maintain the EDMS to ensure documents are accurately filed in accordance with established document control procedures
Work with key stakeholders to populate and maintain each Master Document Register (MDR) and Document Distribution Matrix (DDM) for your assigned project area, ensuring deliverables are tracked and distributed appropriately
Set up automated distributions based on the DDM to ensure timely and accurate delivery of documents to relevant stakeholders
Assist internal and external parties in preparing and submitting documentation with correct metadata and access permissions
Help the site team locate and compile documentation required for regulatory compliance and project handover
Provide one-on-one support and training to project team members on document management processes, including locating, exporting, reviewing, and approving documents
Contribute to the development and refinement of document control procedures and work instructions
Respond to information requests and technical queries related to documentation as needed
Assist with tasks such as verifying document formatting and compliance with templates, printing/scanning, and managing physical document archives

Your characteristics
To succeed in this role, you are highly organized, detail-oriented and proactive, with a strong focus on achieving results. You have excellent communication and time management skills and enjoy collaborating with others, while also being able to take responsibility and work independently when needed. You are adaptable and comfortable managing several tasks simultaneously, always maintaining a structured and solution-oriented approach. Furthermore, you are confident in taking initiative, sharing your knowledge and supporting colleagues to ensure smooth and efficient workflows.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Fot this position we only accept applications written in English.
Qualifications:
A degree in Engineering, a related field or equivalent experience
5+ years of experience working as a Document Controller or in a similar capacity
A thorough understanding of the document and data requirements of construction projects
Previous experience working with electronic document management systems
Proficiency in English (written and verbal), with the ability to clearly communicate technical information

Meriting:
Previous experience working with Omega365, Autodesk Construction Cloud is a plus

Contract type and hours
Full-time consulting assignment through Perido until 2027-06-30. Start 2026-12-15.
Let us help you take the next step in your career
Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36157 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

Experienced in open pit mining? Take on broad technical responsibilities and help shape the future of mining at Björkdalsgruvan.
Would you like to use your experience in open pit mining to influence both technical solutions and operational practices? As a Senior Open Pit Mining Engineer at Björkdalsgruvan, Sweden, you’ll take on broad responsibilities covering mine design, mine planning, drilling, blasting and water management.You’ll join a lean organisation with short decision-making processes, working closely with production and seeing your recommendations put into practice. In this newly established role, you’ll share your expertise and contribute to both the existing open pit operation and the planning of a larger future open pit.This is an opportunity to combine technical expertise with a broader perspective on mine development in an international environment where English is the working language.
Purpose, Offer and Benefits
Work in a lean organisation with close collaboration and the opportunity to see your technical recommendations put into practice.
An international and collaborative work environment where people, safety, practical problem-solving and continuous improvement are key priorities.
A flexible and rewarding work environment with competitive employment conditions and benefits, including a wellness allowance and a healthcare fund.
Flexible working hours based on trust and 30 days of annual leave.

Your Responsibilities
Develop and optimise open pit mine design, mining sequences and short- and long-term production planning.
Plan bench development and mining sequences, contributing to the future development of Björkdal´s open pit operations.
Provide technical support for drilling and blasting, including design, quality control and performance monitoring.
Work with dewatering, drainage and water management to prepare new mining areas.
Monitor production performance and technical data, translating analysis into improvements in safety, productivity and cost efficiency.
Support production technicians through technical problem-solving, knowledge sharing and the development of operational practices.

The Bigger Picture
This is a full-time, permanent position based at Björkdalsgruvan, near Skellefteå, Sweden. You will work regular daytime hours with flexible working arrangements based on trust and responsibility. The role is primarily site-based, with some flexibility depending on operational needs.
This is a newly established position where you will work closely with a small team consisting of two production technicians and a supervisory function. Initially, you will report directly to the Mine Manager and collaborate with the mine´s other planning functions.
Björkdal´s open pit operations are entering an exciting phase of development. The existing open pit has an expected remaining operational life of 3–4 years, while a potential expansion of the original Björkdal main open pit could extend operations by at least another 5–6 years. This offers you the opportunity to contribute to both ongoing production and technical challenges that will shape the mine´s long-term development.
Our Expectations
The most important qualification is several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining operations. You may have worked as a Mining Engineer, Open Pit Engineer, Mine Planner or Drill and Blast Engineer.
To succeed in this role, you will need:
Several years of hands-on technical engineering experience in open pit mining.
A solid understanding of mine design, mine planning, drilling and blasting.
A degree in Mining Engineering or equivalent relevant experience.
Experience with mine planning and design software, along with the ability to learn new systems.
A valid Category B driving licence and good English communication skills.

It would be an advantage if you have:
Swedish language skills.
Experience supporting and developing other technical team members.

As a person, you are solution-oriented and confident in your technical judgement. You can identify challenges, develop practical solutions and clearly communicate your recommendations to colleagues with different areas of expertise. You are comfortable working independently while also valuing close collaboration with production and technical teams.
Interested?
The recruitment process is carried out in collaboration with Talent Navigation Group (TNG), a recruitment and staffing company, and the technical recruitment specialists at TNG Tech. By taking a broader perspective on technical expertise, they identify more engineers, technicians and managers who match the needs of Swedish employers, both today and in the future.We look forward to receiving your application with your CV or LinkedIn profile. No cover letter is required.Please note that we do not accept applications via email, but you are always welcome to contact the recruiter by email if you have any questions.Once you have submitted your application, we will anonymise your personal information and invite you to complete a couple of recruitment assessments before conducting an initial objective evaluation. You will receive more information about each step as the process progresses, and you can track the status of your application in real time through our website.Please note that applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
Would you like to work in an international environment while enjoying life in sunny Cyprus? Are you passionate about helping people and solving problems? Then we have an exciting opportunity for you!
Jobs By Nordics is looking for a Norwegian-speaking Customer Support Advisor to join our international partner in Larnaca, Cyprus.
You'll be working with customer service and technical support for a well-established digital communication platform that helps individuals, businesses, and public organizations communicate securely and manage important digital documents.
This is an excellent opportunity to develop your customer service and IT support skills while gaining valuable international experience.
💻 Your Responsibilities
As a Customer Support Advisor, you'll assist Norwegian-speaking customers with questions about digital services and technical issues.
Your daily responsibilities will include:
Providing customer support via phone, email, and live chat.
Assisting customers with digital messages, documents, and online platforms.
Troubleshooting technical issues with websites and mobile applications.
Guiding customers to the correct departments or support teams.
Handling inquiries from both private individuals and business customers.
Escalating complex cases to the appropriate internal teams or external partners.
Ensuring customers receive professional, efficient, and friendly support.

You'll receive training in the systems and services you'll be working with, ensuring you're well prepared for your new role.
💰 Salary & Benefits
Base salary: €1,350 gross per month.
Salary increase: €1,400 gross per month after 6 months.
Performance bonus: €0.15 per handled case, with no fixed upper limit.
Income tax: 0% income tax in Cyprus at these salary levels, assuming no other taxable income affects your tax position. Mandatory social insurance and healthcare contributions still apply.

The performance bonus depends on the number of cases handled. No average monthly bonus has been specified by the employer.
💼 Working Hours & Employment Conditions
Full-time position: 40 hours per week.
Rotating shifts Monday to Sunday between 09:00 and 21:00.
Training takes place Monday to Friday, 09:00–17:30.
Office-based position in Larnaca, Cyprus.
Opportunity to work in a diverse and international environment.

✈️ Relocation Support – We'll Help You Move to Cyprus!
If you're relocating to Cyprus from another EU country, the employer offers two relocation options to help you settle into your new life.
Option 1 – €1,500 Relocation Allowance
Receive a €1,500 relocation allowance approximately 2–3 weeks after your employment begins.
You'll arrange and pay for your own flight and accommodation, allowing you to choose the solution that works best for you.
Option 2 – Flight Reimbursement & Temporary Accommodation
Potential reimbursement of flight costs up to €300.
Access to employer-provided accommodation for up to 2 months.
The first month of accommodation is free.
A second month may be available for an additional cost, subject to specific conditions.

Please note that staying for a second month affects eligibility for flight reimbursement, and additional accommodation fees may apply. Full relocation terms will be explained during the recruitment process.
🙋 Who Are We Looking For?
We're looking for someone who:
Speaks and writes Norwegian at a native or near-native level (C2).

Has good English communication skills (minimum B2).

Holds EU citizenship, as required by the employer.

Has completed secondary education or equivalent.
Has excellent communication skills and enjoys helping others.
Is comfortable using computers and learning new digital systems.
Has a positive, structured, and solution-oriented mindset.
Is ready to relocate to Larnaca or already lives in Cyprus.

Previous experience in customer service, technical support, or a similar role is an advantage, but not required.
Knowledge of Danish is considered an additional advantage, but is not required.
🌴 Why Choose Cyprus?
Working abroad is about much more than just your job!
Cyprus offers the opportunity to build an international career while enjoying a relaxed Mediterranean lifestyle.
Larnaca is known for its beautiful beaches, sunny weather, welcoming cafés and restaurants, and diverse international community.
Whether you want to gain professional experience, meet new people, or experience life outside Norway, Cyprus could be the perfect place for your next adventure.
You'll have the opportunity to develop your professional skills, improve your English, and create unforgettable memories along the way.
📩 Apply Today!

Application deadline: January 4, 2027
Submit your application and CV through Jobs By Nordics.

Department of Forest Genetics and Plant Physiology
Third-cycle subject area
Biology
Description of the doctoral project
 
The apical hook is a temporary organ structure that forms at the tip of the stem (hypocotyl) in darkness, aiding the germinating seedling as it emerges through the soil. Apical hook formation serves as an excellent model to study plant morphogenesis, as it involves distinct phases of growth promotion and inhibition. The phytohormone indole-3-acetic acid (IAA) is central to plant morphogenesis. This project focuses on investigating the modulation of auxin's spatiotemporal distribution in response to mechanochemical signals during development in Arabidopsis thaliana.
About the position
The research will utilize a range of approaches, including molecular biology techniques, cell biology methods (such as confocal and electron microscopy), mechncobiology experiments, physiological studies, proteomics, and genetic analysis.
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have:
been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification;
satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or
acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
You must have equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.

You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
Your profile
The applicant should have a strong interest in plant biology, molecular plant biology, mechanobiology or related fields. A background in cell and molecular biology is essential. Previous experience or expertise in mechanobiology or plant cell wall biology would be considered an advantage.
The successful candidate should be highly motivated, driven and curious, with good interpersonal and communication skills. After an initial training period, they are expected to take increasing responsibility for their research, show initiative, and work independently, while continuing to receive guidance from their supervisor.
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English are essential.
Beyond academic qualifications, we place great importance on personal integrity, honesty, open communication and a collaborative attitude. We are looking for someone who is comfortable discussing both successes and difficulties, communicates openly about challenges and mistakes, takes responsibility for their work and contributes positively to a supportive and constructive research environment.
About us
The Department of forest genetics and plant physiology is part of Umeå Plant Science Centre (UPSC, https://www.upsc.se/) which is a centre of excellence for experimental plant research and forest biotechnology in Northern Sweden. Our mission is to perform excellent and innovative basic research and generate knowledge that benefits forestry, agriculture, environment and society. We work across a wide range of disciplines in plant science reaching from cell biology to ecophysiology and from basic research to industrial applications. Our common goal is to understand the plants’ ability to grow, adapt and acclimate to a changing world and how we can breed better plants.

The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Ready to kick-start your career at the intersection of systems engineering, AI, and commercial business flows? On behalf of our client, a fast-growing, globally active Swedish medtech company, Academic Work is looking for a newly graduated engineer to automate and develop business-critical systems. With close mentorship from senior architects, you will quickly grow into a key role in an international environment based in central Stockholm. Apply today—we review applications on an ongoing basis!
About the role
Our client is a leading global MedTech company developing clinically researched, objective testing software for ADHD evaluation. Used by thousands of clinicians worldwide, their technology helps healthcare providers make faster, more accurate diagnoses and improve patient outcomes.
As a Junior Business System Integrations Engineer, you will join a tight-knit architecture team consisting of four employees. You will receive dedicated coaching and daily support from senior architects. Your main focus will be streamlining and automating internal processes through scripting, API integrations, and system configuration rather than traditional web or app development. Acting as a bridge between technology and business, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in Finance and Commercial, as well as maintain ongoing dialogue with external system vendors. The role is based at our client’s office near Humlegården in Stockholm, following a hybrid work model where you are expected to be on-site at least three days a week.
This is initially a 6-month consulting assignment through Academic Work, with great opportunities for long-term employment with our client thereafter
You are offered
A unique opportunity to build valuable experience within the regulated and expanding global medtech industry.
Close mentorship and continuous support from senior architects in a welcoming, low-prestige environment.
Hands-on experience working at the forefront of modern AI tools for code generation and system automation.
An international workplace collaborating across global markets, including the UK and the US.

Work tasks
This role focuses on backend development, business system integrations, and process automation rather than frontend or app development. You will work closely with internal teams to ensure data flows securely and efficiently across platforms.
Take technical ownership of the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of NetSuite and Salesforce.  
Build and maintain integrations between business systems, the data lake, and the AWS platform using REST APIs (JSON payloads) and AWS Lambdas.  
Automate manual workflows and commercial processes using Python and TypeScript scripts as well as low-code tools.  
Leverage modern AI coding assistants to accelerate development, focusing on reviewing, understanding, and ensuring the quality of generated code.  
Write and optimize database queries in SQL, SuiteQL, and SOQL to extract, validate, and reconcile business data.  
Collaborate closely with Finance and Commercial teams to translate business requirements (from quote-to-order and contracts to usage and billing) into concrete technical solutions.  
Ensure high data integrity, accurate numerical reconciliation, and strict compliance with data privacy and information security standards.  
Coordinate and communicate with external system suppliers regarding ongoing integrations and system updates.

We are looking for
A recently completed academic degree (M.Sc. or B.Sc.) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering and Management, or a related technical field.
A solid foundation in programming (such as Python, Java, or TypeScript) and the ability to quickly grasp system architecture and codebases.
A basic understanding of commercial and financial flows, including quote-to-order, contracts, invoicing, and usage-based billing.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken, as English is the corporate language (Swedish is not required, though you must hold a valid work permit for Sweden).

Prior experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, or AWS is not required—what matters most is your technical foundation, business curiosity, and ability to learn quickly.
To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Business-minded and communicative: You enjoy interacting with people, feel comfortable initiating dialogue with colleagues and external vendors, and can turn vague requests into clear technical specifications.
Detail-oriented and quality-driven: You are meticulous with numbers, always double-check that data reconciles before handing it over, and respect the high standards of data privacy required in medtech.
Analytical problem-solver: You quickly understand cause and effect in complex environments and are motivated by building smart, automated solutions.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.
